findings.execution_status: Static source finding; no reproduction executed.
findings.finding: The current-consumer branch checks support before authority_check(), then returns cached categories without a post-authority helper check.
findings.reason: The captured proxy authority check invokes callable normalization through its values() closure. A helper change at the final authority-return boundary is invisible to the earlier support check, although an uncached second classification would observe it.
findings.required_change: Revalidate supported helper/alias state after the authority callback and immediately before consuming cached facts. Preserve callback exceptions and derive through the original route when unsupported.
findings.source_demonstration: A deterministic profiling control can change _tool_call_risk_category_set on return from the captured authority check whose caller is InvocationRiskFacts.categories with consumer=current. The existing category/schema global bindings detect that change only if supported() runs again.
